data.title: Compare shelf layouts with product proxies
data.summary: A 10 by 8 m shop, four shelves and a marked circulation route. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: InstancedMesh shares geometry/materials across multiple world transforms.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / Three.js environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A 10 by 8 m shop, four shelves and a marked circulation route.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent retail layout workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A 10 by 8 m shop, four shelves and a marked circulation route. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Reuse approved shelf and product proxies; place from a layout table
Keep aisle envelopes visible as separate non-rendered guides
Compare two layouts from entry and cashier viewpoints, then walk the route

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.

validation: The marked circulation envelope remains unobstructed
The product count is identical across layout alternatives
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Accessibility, fire and merchandising compliance need their own qualified review.

tips: Keep stock count constant to avoid misleading density comparisons.

data.prompt: Help me compare shelf layouts with product proxies in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A 10 by 8 m shop, four shelves and a marked circulation route. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: The marked circulation envelope remains unobstructed; The product count is identical across layout alternatives. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
